It seems incomplete.flavor—Stories yet untold despite the tower that marks a spooky site. When humans flee their home of old, where they settle cannot be told.

metadata.description: A recollection of the life and deeds of Mad King Thorn, as recounted by his loyal subjects. The volume ends with the coronation of King Thorn. It seem incomplete.flavor—Stories yet untold despite the tower that marks a spooky site. When humans flee their home of old, where they settle cannot be told.

In which his Royal Madness, yet but a boy, discovers the joys of humor.flavor—Dig deep in the Muck, where all the garbage of Lion's Arch flows. (Site #1)—Find Provernic, where the first king's bones rot in the hills. (Site #5)
metadata.hint: Under a Lion's Courtglass sky the journey begins again, footsteps placed upon footprints, the mad Your Mad King says...following Mad King Thornthe mad.

metadata.description: In which a friend joins young Oswald Thorn for the adventure of a lifetime.flavor—Say more now and look more where Kryta's descendants are buried. (Site #3)—Go into the hills and set down black roots in stagnant waters (Site #4)

In which Os woos Lady Lyrica with graceless verve and uncomfortable silences.flavor—Go into the hills and set down black roots in stagnant waters (Site #4)—Find Provernic, where the first king's bones rot in the hills. (Site #5)
metadata.hint: Scan Etheric FieldSearch the dead streets and forgotten thoroughfares of Old Lion's Archanother Lion's Arch.

metadata.description: In which Os and his elder brother, Ewie, get into a sticky situation. Only one returns.flavor—Deep in the muck, where all the garbage of Lion's Arch flows. (Site #1)—Search the dead streets and forgotten thoroughfares of another Lion's Arch. (Site #2)
In which Zola's father is afforded special hospitality during her engagement to King Thorn..flavor—Hint: These old bones are caught in the gullet, where laughing rises from sorrow.
metadata.gallery1: Mad Memoires IX-Pains of Love map.jpg

metadata.description: In which Lord Oswald Thorn, the new heir to the throne, chooses his queen.flavor—Say more now and look more where Krysta's descendants are buried. (Site #3)—Find Provernic, where the first king's bones rot in the hills. (Site #5)

In which his Royal Madness ascends to the Krytan throne and wields his first decree.—flavorSearch the dead streets and forgotten thoroughfares of another Lion's Arch. (Site #2)—Say more now and look more where Kryta's descendants are buried. (Site #3)
In which King Thorn relieves thieves of their hands.
metadata.hint: Stores yet untold despite the tower that marks a spooky site. When humans flee their home of old, where they settle cannot be told.

metadata.description: In which the Mad King cries, "Let them eat candy corn!"flavor—This hinterland village was home to a goddess and a martyr.
metadata.gallery1: Mad Memoires VIII-Feast and Famine map.jpg

metadata.description: In which the king makes an example of ungrateful peasants.flavor—Hint: The landing at Arca struggles to fill its storeroom so it will never starve again.
In which a rebellious village goes up in flames.flavor—Hint: Green is the color I want to remember. Not the red of flames or the blackened plateau. The bridge, even it was green.
metadata.gallery1: Mad Memoires XI Flames of Renewal.jpg
metadata.gallery2: Mad Memoires XI-Flames of Renewal map.jpg

metadata.description: In which Mad King Thorn is scattered to the four winds and departs for the Underworld.
metadata.hint: Walk in cadence with King Thorn's shattered subjects. They keep their hatred deep within.

metadata.description: In which the Mad King discovers an empty kingdom waiting to be built upon.
metadata.hint: In the Lion's ArchMad King's city, a Lunatic Noble Acreninoble observes a Miyanikindred spirit far from home, a Mystic Forgecauldron brewing with grim omens.

metadata.description: In which the right to rule over a realm's existing tenants is demonstrated.
metadata.hint: Watching over a maze of bloodshed, the ferryman waits to direct the king's guests.

metadata.description: In which, without a world to conquer, one is created.
metadata.hint: At the heart of a labyrinth, the Mad King's most faithful servant toils at his tasks.

metadata.description: In which a prison's bars are thinning, eroding, slipping, days into weeks.
metadata.hint: Carving out warnings where the king holds court, a rider makes his yearly rounds.
metadata.gallery1: Mad Memoires XVI- Hallowed Eves map.jpg

metadata.description: In which there is not room enough in all the worlds for two undying kings.
metadata.hint: A general prepares for an eternal war, waiting at the gates to another world's battles.

metadata.description: In which the Mad King's followers recruit fresh blood into his court, ever awaiting King Thorn's majestic return to his first kingdom's throne.
metadata.hint: Above the muck and saltwater, a garden stage is decorated in celebration of a royal return.
metadata.gallery1: Mad Memoires XVIII- Binding Agreement map.jpg

metadata.description: flavorTo think that we'd have to go up that high! I think fate is waiting on us, skritt-friend. Adventure is out there!
metadata.hint: Didn't you have to scale this Monument to have a skyscale egg experience acrophobia? Luckily, we took a small detour to look at some flowers.

metadata.description: flavorTo think there's so much danger just south of Lion's Arch. piratessic, jungle wurms, Frost Legion...
metadata.hint: Keeping your balance while carrying an explosive keg through the Depths was quite a challenge, not to mention the large wurm heads.

metadata.description: flavorI wonder if we'll find any more scratches of this size out there. So fascinating.
metadata.hint: The only thing Hidden about this place was those branches. So many roller beetles were caught on them.

metadata.description: flavorTo awaken from a dream into the real world must be a shock. How do you know friend from foe? But no time for dark thoughts. Lets check out the market.
metadata.hint: We had our own vista with a view of the Bay, the market, the hylek, and the tengu.

metadata.description: This area feels like the Eternal Battlegrounds. Risen everywhere! What if the gods came back and saw these shrines?flavorRemember going around the temples trying to control the statues?
metadata.hint: I am thirsty from all the walking we did, but I would not trust any of the Water here.

metadata.description: flavorHey, you said you were some kind of gladium? And that's a bad thing? Well, I think you're good just cause you're you. I can tell there's something special about you, skritt-friend.
metadata.hint: I couldn't participate in that fest after seeing all those cattle. I'd rather just visit a different Town and have strawberries.

metadata.description: flavorI once told you about the quality armor the Granite Citadel used to have centuries ago. Wonder what that looked like.
metadata.hint: When you thought were close to the Peak, a dredge would knock you back.

metadata.description: flavorGetting lost during the sandstorm was harrowing. Still, I'm glad these Zephyrite crystals gave us a taste of what having a raptor or springer is like.
metadata.hint: The Prospect of something happening to what you call home is a scary thought.

metadata.description: flavorIt’s remarkable that after all these years, there are those that think the treaty was a bad idea. Just look at what all the races of Tyria accomplished together.
metadata.hint: There sure are a lot of smashed chickens, as if someone was intentionally triggering Cave-ins.

metadata.description: flavorRemember defending and clearing the way to the Citadel of Flame?
metadata.hint: There were so many of them on that bridge, I am surprised they weren’t called the Baelfire Legion.

metadata.description: flavorEver heard of the famous collectors Professor Yakkington and Nicholas the Traveler? I feel there’s a lot of us hoarders out there. Never know when you might need something!
metadata.hint: They said “Watch the ledges,” so we did. It’s a nice view despite seeing the chaos in the Tundra when that ice dragon was around.
metadata.gallery1: Work Hard for Now Frostgorge Sound.jpg

metadata.description: flavorThere were so many evacuees after the attack. It’s hard to imagine losing your home. Thankfully, the Vigil offered a place of safety while we tried to help those still trapped.
metadata.hint: How many walls did you think were Bluffing you? I really thought this mountain was the entrance.

metadata.description: flavorYou helped friendly skritt from danger! I’ve learned that you will be around no matter how things go, skritt-friend.
metadata.hint: I don’t know what I hated the most in the Woods: the spiders, the bandit with the pistol, or the skritt that threw bears.

metadata.description: flavorWhile you were deep in thought about that big cauldron, I went off the to chase the big shiny. You can’t change the past. Don’t lose sight of the present moment.
metadata.hint: I wanted to Run around this place but felt I was being chased by either a suspicious charr or some anomaly-looking thing.

metadata.description: flavorThe Krytans cannot catch a break. First the Tower of Nightmares, then Fort Salma, Lake Doric, and Garenhoff losing their tower. Guess you can’t let hard times get you down.
metadata.hint: It was peaceful here in the Meadows, but now you can get a good look at the ruins of a fort and tower.

metadata.description: flavorEver hear the legend about the adventurers paying for someone to make the dangerous trek to Droknar’s Forge? Making the trip south in this weather? No thanks!
metadata.hint: She thought it was a False hope that we could stop the Twisted Marionette.

metadata.description: flavorI wonder what it would have been like to know Lyssa back then. She would be so shiny to look at. Anyway, we made it this far.
metadata.hint: Getting to that vista seemed like it was another hidden Garden jumping puzzle back in our day.

metadata.description: flavorDo you remember Hunger Royale? Imagine it was Southsun Survival, but with teams.
metadata.hint: It I was participating in Hunger Royale, a Wild idea would be to hang around a potato farm.

metadata.description: flavorI don’t understand some of those quaggan. We were trying to rescue them, but they got all angry and attacked the krait. Guess they really wanted revenge.
metadata.hint: We needed to go back to the Coil and look for more clues on this “Mordremoth.”

metadata.description: flavorIt is quite something to think there were adventurers that never experienced the Searing.
metadata.hint: Why did they have so much garlic bread in the catacombs? Do you think we will find more in the Ruins of their city?

metadata.description: flavorAfter all the adventurers, I feel like this is my favorite place to visit. It is relaxing and cheery, even if it does have bandits, Wolfwolves, centaurs, and mean skritt.
metadata.hint: You took a break at some Heartwoods, but adventurers were already taking out trolls, boars, bandits, wasps, oakhearts, and spiders.

metadata.description: flavorWe did a lot of practicing on our roller beetles. For a relatively short course, the timings for those turns are tight. We got so close to gold.
metadata.hint: There’s something surreal about hanging around inside an abandoned building, but at least you can hear Owls.

metadata.description: flavorThe Consortium has a weird definition of vacation. There were explosive mines, drakes, and lots of karka out there. But the beach was nice.
metadata.hint: It did not feel good chasing a karka back to a Cavern where there could have been more dangers lying in wait.

metadata.description: flavorI liked learning about the hylek. They seem like such a nice bunch. But we have to see the dragon champion, skritt-friend.
metadata.hint: If I was on the cliffs, I would be safe from any tidal waves that crashed on the Coast. It would be a disaster if you couldn’t find any launch pads in time.

metadata.description: flavorThe Invasion of Orr was a sight to behold.
metadata.hint: Using the Catacombs as a shortcut probably wasn’t the best idea. It’s like a maze down there.

metadata.description: flavorI would think more skritt would live here given all the shiny chests.
metadata.hint: Sometimes you were Desperate and needed to get airship support when defending your fort.

metadata.description: flavorIt seems the scratch here learned a bit from the norn by Kyesjard.
metadata.hint: To think Mordremoth could destroy a fort so Rapidly, and now we can’t use the waypoint anymore!

metadata.description: flavorIt’s a fascinating realization that there’s only a small bit of greenery outside their homeland. Even with my fur, I still don’t enjoy the cold much.
metadata.hint: Have you seen Issormir? That is a large wurm. It is worth the Climb.

metadata.description: FlavorShe looked at him with waning eyes. He would be the last to leave her.
FlavorHer realm was cool and dark; not an empty darkness, but a soft one.
Flavor"Good night," she whispered. They were little more than speckles of light.
FlavorDon't step out of the light, little one.
FlavorThey would know that she knew, and that scared her more than anything.
FlavorInnocent flickers of pure magic, they were. Innocent, but destined.
FlavorIn those final moments, she could see them. Some smiled.
FlavorAnd then there was nothing but dust and shadow.
FlavorJormagThey looked at Soo-Wonher with those icy blue eyes. She disappointed them.
FlavorI did as any mother would; I wept for Elder Dragonthem.
FlavorAround her neck its tendrils wrapped. She could feel no more.
FlavorBefore there was a "them," there was nothing but swirling stars.
FlavorThey tethered me to the world. Without them, I'd have floated away.
FlavorWhen the egg hatched, she felt the world sigh.
FlavorEvery wound, every tear; she felt them live. And die.
FlavorVoidIt slithered through Soo-Wonher like a wurm in the jungle. It preyed on her.
This soot-covered ring appears to be humming with magic.
